CustomField.description: Indicates whether an active IEP record exists for the student in the New York City Department of Education’s Special Education Student Information System (SESIS). The “Flag: Misaligned OSIS” value is used when the student’s OSIS number in Salesforce does not match the one in SESIS, preventing automatic verification.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: SESIS (Special Education Student Information System): Indicates whether the student’s IEP exists in the NYC DOE SESIS system.
CustomField.label: Is there an IEP on SESIS?
